T:P1.2.text: Curaleaf is a leading medical and recreational marijuana dispensary in the United States. We serve 350k+ registered patients across 23 states. Shop now!

C:P1.1.text: MariMed Inc | Premier Cannabis MSO & Brand Innovator

C:P1.2.text: MariMed Inc (MRMD) is a leading multi-state cannabis operator crafting award-winning brands like Betty's Eddies and Nature's Heritage across MA, MD, IL, DE, and MO.

C:P1.3.text: We're on a Mission to Improve Lives Through the Power of Cannabis

C:P1.5.text: MariMed is a leading cannabis operator and brand innovator, dedicated to creating high-quality products that promote wellness and improve lives.

C:P1.6.text: Handcrafting a Path to Wellness with Award-Winning Brands

C:P1.7.text: Our diverse portfolio of brands meets the unique needs of every customer, from wellness seekers to lifestyle enthusiasts.

C:P1.8.text: Our dispensaries deliver an exceptional experience, combining premium products with expert guidance in a welcoming environment. Our knowledgeable team is dedicated to helping every customer find the perfect product for their lifestyle.

C:P1.9.text: Our team is driven by a shared passion for the power of cannabis. Together, we foster a culture of collaboration, integrity, and wellness in everything we do.

C:P1.10.text: Betty's Eddies drops Smashin' Passion just in time for Valentine's Day.

C:P1.11.text: Vibations signals a significant shift in the wellness industry.

C:P1.12.text: Eat This Edible: Betty's Eddies brings Missourians even more THC to chew.

C:P1.13.text: Check out Betty's Eddies in the Maryland Leaf Staff Picks: Edibles Edition.

C:P1.14.text: We're Growing Towards a Better Future

C:P2.1.text: About MariMed Inc | Cannabis Industry Pioneer & MSO

C:P2.2.text: Discover MariMed's journey from cannabis pioneers to a leading MSO. Learn about our mission, values, and commitment to premium cannabis products and innovation.

C:P2.3.text: Over 10 Years of Experience Handcrafting Cannabis Excellence

C:P2.4.text: We leverage our innovation and world-class facilities to create award-winning brands that meet consumer desires.

C:P2.5.text: From product selection to ease of transactions, our stores deliver an exceptional shopping experience.

C:P2.6.text: We find ways to support the local communities and the customers we serve everyday.

C:P2.7.text: We're proud to serve customers in leading cannabis markets.

C:P2.8.text: We're a multi-state operator, or what the cannabis industry calls an "MSO." What it really means is that we aim to make our brands available to as many people in as many states as possible.

C:P2.9.text: Click on our map to learn more.

C:P2.10.text: Kind has given me opportunities to grow and learn as a person and a cannabis cultivator. I enjoy sharing this working experience with my team and all the great people working here.

C:P2.11.text: It's a pleasure to come to work knowing what we do is not only fulfilling in my own life but helps so many others.

C:P2.12.text: I thoroughly enjoy my work and all the people I work with. Being with Kind 5+ years, every day is a new and exciting adventure! I look forward to continued growth within the company and the endless opportunities for advancement.

C:P2.13.text: I've always been a huge advocate of plant medicine and natural healing methods. By working here, I get to contribute to that cause every day!
